steps.code:
# I have 3 roommates: Kathryn, Nancy, Troy. Including me, 4 people total.
# Taxi: $40 / 4 = $10 per person. I paid, so each roommate owes me $10 for "Commute".
# Food: $166 / 4 = $41.50 per person. Nancy paid, so I owe Nancy $41.50 for "Dinner".

# Let me create payment requests for $10 from each roommate with note "Commute"
for roommate in roommates:
    req = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=roommate["email"],
        amount=10.0,
        access_token=venmo_access_token,
        description="Commute"
    )
    print(f"Request to {roommate['first_name']}: {req}")
